coverage_questions: The paper documents a separate 0.36B-parameter GenNA version, but does not document its input construction, tokenizer receipt, decoder configuration, generation routes, or receiving component; no 0.36B trajectory is invented.
The paper does not specify tokenizer special-token behavior, padding values, attention masks, loss masks, sequence-boundary handling, or exact segmentation of packed inputs into context windows.
The paper does not provide the exact decoder input/label shift used for causal language-model training.
The paper does not document the internal Transformer computation that converts token IDs into hidden states, logits, or next-token distributions.
The paper does not specify whether optional species and gene fields are represented by omission, empty fields, or special tokens in the unified generation template.

The paper does not specify the exact implementation of softmax, temperature scaling, nucleus candidate-set construction, repetition penalties, no-repeat n-gram filtering, or termination handling beyond the stated decoding description.
The paper does not document the exact extraction and translation implementation used for generated CDS evaluation; those procedures are downstream validation rather than model-input construction.
The paper does not specify the exact implementation of conditional perplexity, mutation ΔPPL, or species-label ΔPPL beyond defining their documented input comparisons and metrics.
The paper documents exhaustive all-annotation sequence-function pairings and all pairwise species-label substitutions, but does not provide separate serialized examples for every resulting branch.
